title: 九百九十八天
title_py: jiǔ bǎi jiǔ shí bā tiān

title_tr.fa: روز نهصد و نود و هشتم پروژه

lines.text: 公司准备给一家欧洲连锁超市做一大批不锈钢锅，按照对方的要求，杰克要先去宁波的供应商那儿验厂。
lines.py: gōng sī zhǔn bèi gěi yì jiā ōu zhōu lián suǒ chāo shì zuò yí dà pī bú xiù gāng guō, àn zhào duì fāng de yāo qiú, Jié kè yào xiān qù níng bō de gōng yìng shāng nà r yàn chǎng.
lines.en: The company is preparing a big batch of stainless-steel pans for a European supermarket chain, and as the buyer requires, Jack first has to go and audit the supplier's factory in Ningbo.

lines.text: 一进厂门，他就看见墙上挂着一块红色的大牌子，上面的数字每天都要换：安全生产九百九十八天。
lines.py: yī jìn chǎng mén, tā jiù kàn jiàn qiáng shàng guà zhe yí kuài hóng sè de dà pái zi, shàng miàn de shù zì měi tiān dōu yào huàn: ān quán shēng chǎn jiǔ bǎi jiǔ shí bā tiān.
lines.en: As soon as he's through the gate, he sees a big red board on the wall with a number that changes every day: 998 days of safe production.

lines.en: Jack follows the manager round the workshops all morning: the floors are spotless, the fire extinguishers are neatly lined up, and every item on the audit checklist passes, one after another.

lines.text: 杰克这才明白，那九百九十八天，不一定是真的没出过事，也可能是出了事没人敢说。
lines.py: Jié kè zhè cái míng bai, nà jiǔ bǎi jiǔ shí bā tiān, bù yí dìng shì zhēn de méi chū guò shì, yě kě néng shì chū liǎo shì méi rén gǎn shuō.

lines.text: 下午，他特意多看了几台冲压机，发现其中一台的防护罩松了，只用铁丝随便绑着，工人说已经这样大半年了。

lines.en: That afternoon, he makes a point of looking more closely at the stamping presses, and finds that the safety guard on one of them is loose and just tied on with wire. The workers say it's been like that for the best part of a year.

lines.text: 晚上回到酒店，杰克对着验厂报告坐了很久：如实写，这家工厂很可能拿不到订单；不写，他心里又过不去。

lines.en: Back at the hotel that evening, Jack sits over his audit report for a long time. If he writes it all down truthfully, the factory will very likely lose the order; if he doesn't, his conscience won't let him rest.

lines.py: dìng dān qiān xià lái nà tiān, chǎng zhǎng duì Jié kè shuō: “yǐ qián nà ge shù zì yuè dà, wǒ yuè de yì; xiàn zài zhè ge shù zì yuè dà, wǒ wǎn shang shuì de yuè tā shi.”
lines.en: On the day the order is signed, the manager says to Jack, "The bigger the old number got, the prouder I was. The bigger this new number gets, the better I sleep at night."

tr.am: ትዕዛዙ በተፈረመበት ቀን ኃላፊው ለጃክ እንዲህ አለው፦ «ድሮ ያ ቁጥር በጨመረ ቁጥር ይበልጥ እኮራ ነበር፣ አሁን ይህ ቁጥር በጨመረ ቁጥር ማታ ይበልጥ ተረጋግቼ እተኛለሁ።»
tr.fa: روز امضای سفارش مدیر به جک می‌گه: «هرچی عدد قدیمی بزرگ‌تر می‌شد، من مغرورتر می‌شدم. هرچی این عدد جدید بزرگ‌تر بشه، شب‌ها راحت‌تر می‌خوابم.»
